business_problem: PLDT and Smart were limited by legacy VPN-dependent systems and disconnected service processes that slowed mobile access, customer response times, and employee referrals.
solution_summary: PLDT and Smart were limited by legacy VPN-dependent systems and disconnected service processes that slowed mobile access, customer response times, and employee referrals. PLDT implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around Customer Service Management Pro, Workflow Data Fabric, App Engine, and Automation Engine. Key components included Customer Service Management Pro adds advanced automation for customer support; Workflow Data Fabric connects operational data and automation context; App Engine builds custom workflow apps; Automation Engine automates cross-system tasks. Requests enter through Virtual Agent before Customer Service Management Pro, Workflow Data Fabric, App Engine, and Automation Engine routes or fulfills the work. Updates then flow back to agents, account teams, or customers through the same connected experience. Running customer support and case management on one data model reduced manual handoffs and made expansion easier.
